events.text: A yellow dust storm from the loess hills turns the sky orange over the Central Plains.

choices.text: Tie a cloth over your face and keep walking

effects.log: You arrive covered in dust, looking like a clay statue.
A family in a cave dwelling shares noodles until the wind dies.

events.text: Millet harvest in the loess country. Every hand is needed.

effects.log: A week of dust and songs.

choices.text: Buy millet cakes at the fair

effects.log: Crunchy, sweet, perfect.

events.text: Grave robbers are rumoured to be digging into an old emperor's tomb in the hills.

ok.log: You chase them off. The magistrate sends thanks.

fail.log: There are more of them than rumoured.

effects.log: The garrison rides out.

events.text: A little kung fu school in a market town is so poor the master teaches for rice.

choices.text: Take a lesson and pay generously

effects.log: Old-fashioned, honest forms. (−5 taels)
He is better than his school looks.

events.text: The great cart road is jammed for a li with oxcarts, soldiers and a very angry goose.

effects.log: It takes all day. You make three friends.
Muddy, fast, free.

events.text: A Jiangnan teahouse storyteller tells the tale of the White Snake and the monk. The whole room is spellbound.

effects.log: Love, magic and a pagoda. You weep a little.
Everyone has an opinion. A great evening.

events.text: A village of silk farmers invites you to see the worms spinning.

effects.log: A thousand tiny workers, one miracle.
Hard work, soft reward. The farmers give you a silk scarf.

events.text: A boat trip through water towns in the plum rain season. Every bridge is a painting.

effects.log: Your sketches are bad. The boatman loves them.

choices.text: Sleep to the sound of the rain

effects.log: Deep, green sleep.

events.text: A river merchant offers to carry you downstream for free if you guard his cargo.

ok.log: River pirates try once. Never again. You arrive with a full purse. (+15)

fail.log: You lose one crate to pirates and some skin.

effects.log: A lazy, peaceful trip. (−5 taels)

events.text: A pavilion where famous poets wrote their verses on the walls. Visitors add their own.

ok.log: Yours is admired. Someone copies it down.

fail.log: It is painted over by morning.

effects.log: A thousand years of voices.

events.text: The great stone Buddha carved into the cliff at the river's meeting. Pilgrims climb down the stairs beside it.

effects.log: Your whole body is the size of its toenail.

choices.text: Watch the boats from the top

effects.log: Tiny boats, huge river, huge Buddha.

events.text: Tea bricks pile up in the market, bound for the west. The smell is dark and earthy.

choices.text: Buy a brick for the road

effects.log: A month of good tea. (−3 taels)
You learn the roads to the west.

events.text: Rain on the Sichuan cliffs turns every path into a stream.

choices.text: Wait it out in a monastery

effects.log: The monks share their rice and silence.
Slippery, dangerous, exhilarating.

events.text: A pilgrim on the way to Emei has hurt her ankle.

choices.text: Carry her pack to the next temple

effects.log: She blesses you in a language you do not know.
She walks on, slower and grateful.

events.text: A Sichuan spice merchant bets you cannot eat a whole raw chilli.

ok.log: Your face goes numb. You win the bet. (+3 taels)

fail.log: You lose. And your sense of taste, briefly.

effects.log: The merchant respects wisdom, and keeps his money.

events.text: Nomad horse herders camp by the border, their horses countless.

effects.log: They show you how to ride without a saddle.
Long songs about grass and sky.

events.text: In deep winter, the northern market sells frozen fish stacked like firewood.

effects.log: You carry it home like a sword.

choices.text: Warm your hands at the chestnut stall

effects.log: Hot chestnuts, cold air, good company.

events.text: The frontier fort's night watch is short a man and asks for volunteers.

effects.log: A long, cold, quiet night. The captain remembers you.
The soldiers cheer.

events.text: A northern eagle hunter carries a golden eagle on her arm.

effects.log: Years of patience. You understand a little.
A fox, a dive, a strike.

events.text: A war widow runs an inn on the frontier. Soldiers are gentle in her house.

effects.log: Warm, safe, and full of stories about her husband.

choices.text: Fix her roof before you go

effects.log: She never charges you again.

events.text: The tide pools at low tide: crabs, starfish, and a small octopus that squirts ink at you.

effects.log: You find a pearl oyster. (+5 taels)
It watches you go, deeply offended.

events.text: Sailors from two ships brawl on the docks over a dockside singer.

ok.log: Both crews stop and buy you tea.

fail.log: Both crews throw you in the harbour.

effects.log: The singer ends it by singing louder. Everyone stops to listen.

events.text: The salt wind off the sea gets into everything: your hair, your food, your sword.

effects.log: Your sword never rusts.

choices.text: Let it rust and buy a new one

effects.log: Coastal wisdom. (−5 taels)

events.text: A fishing village invites you to join them for the night catch.

effects.log: Lanterns on the dark water, nets full of silver. (+6 taels)
Patient work. The old women tell you everything about everyone.

events.text: A temple on a rock in the sea, reachable only at low tide.

ok.log: You reach it and pray. The tide traps you there overnight, peacefully.

fail.log: The tide comes in early. You swim back.

effects.log: The sea carries prayers too.

events.text: A caravanserai in the desert: camels, traders, and a hundred languages.

effects.log: A feast of dates, bread and stories.
A good map is worth its weight in water. (−5 taels)

events.text: A valley of grapes in the western desert, green against red rock.

effects.log: Purple hands, sweet grapes.
Sweet and light. (−1 taels)

events.text: A city of mud-brick ruins, half-buried in sand, empty for a thousand years.

ok.log: An old coin with a king's face you do not know. (+10 taels)

fail.log: Sand in everything, and a scorpion in your boot.

effects.log: A thousand years in one sunset.

events.text: A western musician plays a lute with a round body, singing in a language like water.

effects.log: You do not understand a word. You understand everything.
You teach him one of yours. He plays it better.

events.text: Children slide down the great dunes on wooden boards.

effects.log: You slide, tumble and laugh like a child.
The children cheer back.
